# Ennie Coffee

> Ennie Coffee (Ennie Coffee Kávéház) is an independent café in Hatvan, Hungary, at Kossuth tér 10 (3000 Hatvan), welcoming guests since 2015. It serves 100% arabica coffee with a light roast (tasting notes: peach, jasmine, pecan), matcha and chai lattes, milkshakes, fruit smoothies, lemonades and hot chocolate. Table reservations by phone: +36 37 950 875.

The website is in Hungarian. Current prices and opening hours are on the pages below; they are maintained by the café and are the authoritative source.

## Pages

- [Főoldal (home)](/): the café, its coffee, and how to visit
- [Árlista (price list)](/arlista): the full menu by category, with prices in HUF
- [Rólunk (about)](/rolunk): the café's story and its owner, Enikő Molnár
- [Kapcsolat (contact)](/kapcsolat): address, opening hours, phone, e-mail, map and directions
